chunk:
deviations: |
  No dominant cross-vendor standard for construction lead records. Field naming derived from:
    - HD Portal F-number convention (Home Depot Pro contractor channel)
    - Salesforce Lead standard object
    - ComputerEase customer-onboarding fields (downstream consumer)

description: |
  Canonical lead entity for construction / specialty-contractor integrations.
  Maps from: contractor portals (HD Portal — F-number identifier, ServiceTitan, similar pro-channels).
  Maps to:   CRM (Salesforce Lead), construction ERP customer intake (ComputerEase).
  Common synonyms by system:
    F-number      (HD Portal — Home Depot Pro)
    Lead          (Salesforce, generic CRM)
    Prospect      (some ERPs)
    Inquiry       (some service-management tools)

  Peerless-specific: HD F-number is the source-of-truth external identifier and must be
  carried through every downstream record (Salesforce External ID + ComputerEase reference).

required:
  - leadId
  - source
  - status
  - customerName
  - timestamps

properties:
  leadId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical lead identifier
    example: "LEAD-2026-000565"

  externalIds:
    type: object
    description: Source system identifiers
    properties:
      portalLeadId:       { type: string, description: "Lead ID in contractor portal (HD Portal: F-number, e.g. 'F1234567')" }
      salesforceLeadId:   { type: string, description: "Salesforce Lead 18-char ID" }
      crmContactId:       { type: string, description: "Downstream CRM contact ID if lead converts" }

  source:
    type: string
    enum: [HD_PORTAL, SERVICETITAN, WEB_FORM, REFERRAL, WALK_IN, PHONE, OTHER]
    description: Originating channel for the lead

  sourceCampaign:
    type: string
    description: Campaign / program tag from the source (HD Portal: 'Pro contractor', etc.)

  status:
    type: string
    enum: [NEW, CONTACTED, QUALIFIED, QUOTED, WON, LOST, DISQUALIFIED]

  customerName:
    type: string
    description: Homeowner or business name

  customerType:
    type: string
    enum: [RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, INDUSTRIAL]

  contactInfo:
    type: object
    properties:
      phone:        { type: string }
      email:        { type: string, format: email }
      preferredContact: { type: string, enum: [PHONE, EMAIL, TEXT] }

  serviceAddress:
    type: object
    properties:
      street:       { type: string }
      city:         { type: string }
      state:        { type: string }
      postalCode:   { type: string }
      country:      { type:

  scheduled 10-min polling, F-number as the external identifier. Fields to finalize during Analyst PRD:
